The '''Carlac Death Watch camp''' was a base maintained by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter group [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] were brought to the camp by Death Watch [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan Kryze]] after they landed on Carlac.<ref name="AFiN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Death Watch's camp on Carlac first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the fourteenth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]], entitled "[[A Friend in Need]]."
